narrative.summary: The deployer is a HyperEVM StakingVault contract, not a bare key. Its HyperCore signing rights come from an OPERATOR_ROLE Safe with threshold 1 over 3 owners, weaker than a single key, so the score was corrected downward.
narrative.tag: corrected down from the single-key reading
narrative.detail: The generic reading (no HyperCore multisig means a single key) was wrong, because the address is a contract. addApiWallet is gated by OPERATOR_ROLE, held by a Safe with threshold 1 over 3 owners: two bare EOAs and a nested 1-of-1 Safe. The docs do not say in words that an API wallet may sign deployer actions; the repo infers it because a contract has no key and the dex is operated. Live weight: about $15.1M open interest and 35 listed assets at the 2026-09-17 read. Its root key is not shared with any other tracked dex. Stored under a derived key because the same address is also the para StakingVault.

reproduce.note: this RPC cannot replay the block of the build (it ignores the block tag, or no longer serves old state): the call reproduces the current value, not the one of the build; compare the composite and lastUpdated with this page

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: Admin power is not a bare key
main_gap.reason: One key, or a tiny group, can change it

independent_read.why: no code at this address on the chain's mainnet: a derived identifier for a native (non-EVM) entity such as HyperCore, or a contract that lives on another chain (a rollup's own L1 contracts); nothing for this reader to compare here
